# Expert elicitation process {#sec-elicitation}

We have cross-referencing tables from four experts, we identify the expert by their initials: JB, AL, AK, and MGT.

During the first round, the experts used different formats to represent the cross-referencing information.

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ecoSynthesis)
library(ggplot2)
here::i_am("elicitation/index.qmd")
output_dir <- here::here("output-XREFs")
source(here::here("inc/setup.R"))
source(here::here("inc/functions.R"))
```

First we will get two look up tables with the valid members of the source and target classifications:

```{r}
TASVEG_LUT <-
  read_csv(
    here::here(output_dir, "Source-lookup-table.csv"),
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )
table(TASVEG_LUT$eligible)
IUCN_GET_LUT
```

Read data directly from a CSV file into a membership table:

```{r}
TASVEG_memb <- read_membership_tbl(
  here::here(output_dir, "First-round-output.csv"),
  source_id = "VEGCODE",
  target_id = "efg",
  membership = "memb",
  interpreter = "expert"
)

TASVEG_memb
```

Let's check this file for errors:

```{r}
check_membership(TASVEG_memb)
```


## Pairwise dissimilarity

Calculate pairwise dissimilarities

```{r}
(pd <- pairwise_dissimilarity(TASVEG_memb))

plot_pairwise_diss(pd) +
  theme_wp3()
```

```{r}
#| eval: false
efg_order <- sort(unique(TASVEG_memb$efg))
membership_matrix <- profiles |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = efg, values_from = memb) |>
  dplyr::select(VEGCODE, expert, dplyr::any_of(efg_order)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(VEGCODE, expert)

message(
  nrow(membership_matrix),
  " rows (unit × expert) × ",
  length(efg_order),
  " target columns. ",
  "NA = target not used by any expert for that unit; 0 = used by another expert but not this one."
)
head(membership_matrix, 12)
```

## Pairwise expert distances for each unit.
```{r}
#| eval: true

sid <- rlang::sym(attr(pd, "source_id"))

unit_disagreement <- pd |>
  dplyr::group_by(!!sid) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_dissimilarity = mean(dissimilarity),
    min_dissimilarity = min(dissimilarity),
    max_dissimilarity = max(dissimilarity),
    n_pairs = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(mean_dissimilarity), VEGCODE)

msg <- "%s of %s units have identical profiles from every interpreter."

message(
  sprintf(
    msg,
    sum(unit_disagreement$max_dissimilarity < 0.001),
    nrow(unit_disagreement)
  )
)
head(unit_disagreement, 10)

ggplot(unit_disagreement, aes(x = mean_dissimilarity)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.1) +
  theme_wp3()
```
